name: file-patch
description: Apply a Codex apply_patch envelope (*** Begin Patch / Add|Update|Delete File / Move to / @@ anchors) across multiple files in one call. Paths are relative to --cwd; absolute paths and escapes are refused.
use_when: applying a multi-file patch in apply_patch format

args.name: --file
args.description: Patch file path; omit to read patch from stdin.

args.name: --cwd
args.description: Root that relative paths resolve against.

args.name: --dry-run
args.description: Validate and report changes without writing.
